request.deadline: Rare Dev Gov Day on July 28, 2026 and Rare Evo on July 28-31, 2026 in Las Vegas
deliverables: Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream
Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Dev Gov Day 2026
Free General Admission access for the Cardano community
Complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem projects
Travel and lodging support for 20 Cardano ecosystem contributors or volunteers
Five Cardano-focused main stage panel opportunities
Media sponsorship involving 2-3 selected tier-1 media vendors
Return of 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury
request.what: Rare Network requests Cardano treasury funding for Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 main stage/global livestream and Rare Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network states it is requesting ₳2,750,000, valued at $660,000 using a $0.24 ADA price, to fund two Cardano sponsorship packages.

The proposal states the budget includes ₳1,166,666.67 for Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, ₳833,333.33 for Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship and livestream/media sponsorship, and ₳750,000 for Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network says it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current retail VIP ticket price listed as $900.
The proposal claims Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but that treasury funding would expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and industry outreach.
Rare Network claims it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has operated Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The proposal reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social impressions, and 40+ Cardano projects represented.

The proposal states the first Cardano Dev Gov Day in 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included a keynote from Charles Hoskinson plus governance and technical programming.

The proposal says selected Cardano projects and individuals will use open application forms for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer participation, and travel or lodging assistance, with priority given to meaningful ecosystem contribution and in-person participation.

The proposal claims the sponsorship aligns with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability pillars by expanding governance programming, free participation, contributor attendance, workshops, livestream access, and media distribution.

The proposal notes that if the mainstage or livestream sponsorship inventory is sold before approval, Cardano will receive a sponsorship of equal impact or dollar value such as Enterprise & Policy Social, Registration, Closeout Party, or College Row.

summary: The document requests ₳2.75 million for Cardano sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 and Rare Dev Gov Day 2026, provides a detailed spending breakdown and participation benefits, asserts prior event traction and governance relevance, and includes some externally checkable supporting links but lacks independent budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and impact analysis in the supplied assessment.
